first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: crowd of spectators along the route
entities.identification: A densely arranged crowd of spectators behind the barrier on the left side of the road; individual correspondences across different sections of the route are not tracked.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person in the foreground wearing black long sleeves and white gloves and gripping the handlebar; there is a red-and-black rectangular marking on the back of the left hand.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The mountain bicycle operated by Person B, with a black flat handlebar, black front wheel, red front component, and silver controls partially visible.

entities.name: track surface
entities.identification: The grayish-brown, hard-surfaced, narrow sloping road between the barrier on the left and the stone wall on the right.

entities.name: metal barriers along the route
entities.identification: The continuously arranged gray tubular-frame mesh barrier panels on the left side of the road, with some bottom supports extending toward the road.

entities.name: wall beside the track
entities.identification: The irregular rough-stone wall on the right side of the road, with blue-and-white and red-and-white markings on its surface.

entities.name: residential buildings along the route
entities.identification: The group comprising the gray-walled, red-eaved building on the left, the building with a green facade, and the light-colored building ahead.

entities.name: blue sky
entities.identification: The blue sky visible between the buildings, wall tops, and overhead lines.

entities.name: vegetation along the route
entities.identification: The green canopies and clusters of leaves near the distant buildings, on top of the wall, and in a few places at the base of the wall.

entities.name: utility poles along the route
entities.identification: The slender upright poles near the buildings ahead on the left and connected to the overhead lines.

entities.name: cables along the route
entities.identification: The thin, dark overhead lines above and the thin black lines extending along the road edge on the strip of soil on the right.

entities.name: strip of bare soil beside the road
entities.identification: The yellowish-brown strip of soil between the stone wall on the right and the hard road surface, scattered with gravel and dry leaves.

entities.name: spectator-held mobile phone
entities.identification: The set of small, dark or light-colored rectangular mobile phones visible in some spectators' hands.
